children: -- Canadian Life Companies Split Corp. (the "Company") declares its monthly distribution of $0.10000 for each Class A share ($1.20 annualized) and $0.05833 for each Preferred share ($0.700 annualized). Distributions are payable October 9, 2026 to shareholders on record as at September 30, 2026.

Since inception Class A shareholders have received a total of $10.65 per share and Preferred shareholders have received a total of $13.32 per share inclusive of this distribution, for a combined total of $23.97 per unit.

The Company invests primarily in a portfolio of four publicly traded Canadian life insurance companies as follows: Great-West Lifeco Inc., Industrial Alliance Insurance & Financial Services Inc., Manulife Financial Corporation and Sun Life Financial Inc.

title: Canadian Life Companies Split Corp. Declares Class A & Preferred Share Dividend
